$description: Worked example: a measured-style-pack built from a signed-off client deck ('Kwera Health', fictitious), and the W3C-aligned primitive token file it seeds for design-tokens-and-naming. Two parts: 'measured_pack' is what this skill produces (grade/scale/spacing statistics, per the Workflow); 'seeded_primitive_tokens' is the downstream artefact design-tokens-and-naming consumes. Numbers are illustrative, not a real client's actual measurements.

reference.signed_off_by: client brand lead, recorded 2026-08-12 approval email

grade.json.$description: Colour measured per lightness band, OKLCH, median + MAD (not mean/std). Sample counts recorded per band as a confidence signal.
grade.json.note: Signature accent lives in the mid band (L*46, C*0.132, H*152 — a saturated green), not uniform across the deck. Mean chroma across all samples was 0.079 vs this band's median 0.132; using the mean would have understated the accent by ~40%.

scale.json.$description: Type sizes as computed pt values from the deck's text-box properties, converted to a comparable px-equivalent at the deck's export DPI (150).

spacing.json.$description: Gaps measured from deck element bounding boxes.

spec.json.$description: Grounded description, hedge-word-lint clean (verified: node scripts/hedge-word-lint.js spec.json exits 0).
spec.json.text: Accent colour is a saturated mid-tone green (L*46 C*0.132 H*152), absent from both the shadow band and the highlight band. Background share below near-black is 4.1%. Type scale measures a 1.269 median ratio across six sizes, above the 1.25 doctrine floor. Spacing rhythm is built on an 8px base unit (85% of measured gaps match), with 16px as the single most frequent gap.
spec.json.grounding_caveat: This description is grounded in the measurements above; it is not an independent check on them.

seeded_primitive_tokens.$description: TIER 1 -- PRIMITIVE. Fed directly from measured_pack.grade/scale/spacing above, matching the OKLCH + W3C $value/$type shape used by design-tokens-and-naming/examples/tokens.json. Semantic and component tiers are built on top of these the normal way -- not shown here.
